amendment_reason: Adds the analytic origin-curvature target, mandatory orientation-component reporting, and exact edge-retention vocabulary after independent from-specification reproduction. The noise, seed, grid, and prior scaling thresholds are unchanged.
question: Can estimation-noise holonomy on a flat connection be separated from genuine curvature by perimeter-versus-area scaling while matching the main control's worst-direction retention?

geometry.curvature_condition: noncommuting Grassmann field from the matched holonomy control
geometry.noise_null: independent tangent-space subspace resampling at every flat-connection node
geometry.analytic_target: maximum canonical rotation rate of P[dP_s,dP_t]P at the registered origin

primary_statistics.curvature: maximum canonical rotation angle regressed on enclosed loop area
primary_statistics.noise: signed rank-two holonomy-angle variance regressed on perimeter edge count
primary_statistics.higher_rank_summary: sorted canonical rotation angles of the SO(r) conjugacy class
primary_statistics.orientation_summary: det(H) and an orientation-reversal flag; a negative determinant supersedes canonical angles

signed_transport_rule.canonical_path: freeze one rooted spanning tree before outcomes or behavioral labels
signed_transport_rule.off_tree_edges: close audit loops against the tree path and report determinant plus canonical holonomy angles
signed_transport_rule.interpretation: the tree fixes a convention; it does not remove path dependence where curvature is nonzero

claim_boundary: Synthetic scaling-law control only. Passing distinguishes the planted connection-curvature fixture from its registered estimation-noise null; it does not establish real-model curvature or a causal monitor failure.
